reason: Explicitly discretionary intraday price action trading on futures/bonds/FX with no concrete systematic rules that can be coded.

universe.description: bond market, futures, FX, stock indexes

setup.rule: Map support/resistance, trend lines, Fib levels on weekly/daily/60-min; look for trapped traders at swing highs/lows or gap auction failures
setup.quote: I look at for example basic support and resistance levels in the market like on the higher time frames like weekly and daily. I also look at them on 60-minute charts and I look at the basic structure of the market.

setup.rule: Fade momentum after gap + failure at key reference point
setup.quote: when you get a large gap and the price travels in the direction of the gap... we get an auction failure beyond the big reference point... I will usually look to fade that market momentum back towards a gap close.

entry.rule: Discretionary entry based on multiple angles (sentiment, trapped traders, market probing levels) rather than fixed pattern
entry.quote: I am a I'm a discretionary trader. So I don't you're right. I don't trade certain setups systematically because what I'm trying to look for is I'm trying to look for kind of or taking on information from so many different angles

stop.rule: Firm idea of where wrong; avoid moving to breakeven early as it is trading P&L
stop.quote: I have an idea of where I'm looking to take profit and I have a you know a firm idea of where I'm wrong on the trade... why are you moving to break even?... trade the market, don't trade your P&L.

exits.rule: Two styles: run on higher timeframe for big moves or play level-to-level intraday; risk-reward evolves during trade
exits.quote: I have two types of trades. I have those where I feel that the market is poised from a higher time frame to make a big move... the other type of trade is is where I will literally play from one level to the next intraday.

sizing.rule: Trade small to grow account; never vary size by confidence or revenge trade
sizing.quote: I was just basically trading way too large... I refused to trade my P&L anymore. I had to be very disciplined in order to just understand that I was going to have to bet small and grow

market_filter.rule: Use professional sentiment and price action at key levels to determine if market will probe or fail
market_filter.quote: if the chart is technically very bearish and the sentiment is very bearish, but the market won't break, you need to be long.

ambiguities.issue: No specific numbers, patterns or fixed rules given for any setup
ambiguities.assumption: Method cannot be approximated on daily bars or coded as testable strategy

ambiguities.issue: Focus now on bonds/futures not US stocks
ambiguities.assumption: Still applies to classification as discretionary intraday
